name: Typed presentation model with operations
description: Slides of typed text/rect elements on a 1600x900 logical canvas; slide and element operations with geometry clamping; validation; JSON round-trip.
edgeCases: last slide resets instead of emptying deck
update cannot change id/kind or leave canvas
knownLimitations: No masters/layouts/themes, media, or animations yet; PPTX conversion pending (ADR-0007)

name: Slides editor slice
description: Thumbnail rail, canvas editing (drag move, corner resize, double-click inline text editing (styled overlay, blur/Cmd-Enter commits, Esc cancels), properties bar), undo/redo, autosave, present mode with keyboard navigation, JSON export. Shapes: rectangle/ellipse variant with fill; z-order controls (front/forward/backward/back) preserved through PPTX.
acceptance: Boot renders seed deck and thumbnails
Toolbar add + undo round-trips slide count
Autosave persists; present stage renders elements

evidence.ref: ellipse + z-order PPTX round-trip suite: pass

name: PPTX export/import
description: Export decks as complete PresentationML packages; import PPTX (slide order via rels, per-axis EMU scaling incl. 4:3, text style extraction) with PPTX-IMPORT-* loss reports for pictures, frames, groups, mixed runs, and layout-inherited geometry.
acceptance: Package carries every required part and relationship
python-pptx reads slides, shapes, text, dimensions

evidence.ref: import suite (round-trip, loss reports, 4:3 scaling): 4 tests pass; python-pptx fixture imports with 0 warnings

knownLimitations: No animations/media; mixed per-run styling flattened on import; layout-inherited placeholder geometry not resolved; opening in real PowerPoint not yet verified

name: Image elements with PPTX embedding
description: Insert images from file (stored as data URLs, decks stay self-contained); drag/resize like any element; PPTX export embeds real media parts with per-slide relationships, import converts pictures back to image elements with exact bytes; missing media degrades to a placeholder with a warning.
edgeCases: missing media part imports as placeholder rect with warning
acceptance: Export→import round-trips media bytes exactly and preserves geometry
python-pptx sees a PICTURE shape with identical blob
validateDeck rejects image elements without data:image src

evidence.ref: pptx image suites: pass (124 unit total)
python-pptx cross-validation: PICTURE shape, exact bytes

knownLimitations: No cropping, aspect lock, or SVG; data URLs grow deck JSON size

name: Lines and connectors
description: Line element drawn corner-to-corner of its box (dir down/up), with stroke color, width and an optional end arrowhead. Renders as SVG; exports to PPTX as p:cxnSp (prstGeom line, flipV for dir up, a:ln width/color, tailEnd triangle) and imports back.
acceptance: + Line adds a selectable, draggable, resizable line
props bar edits stroke/width/arrow and flips direction
PPTX round-trip preserves geometry (±1 unit), direction, stroke, width, arrow
python-pptx reads exported connectors with exact EMU geometry
edgeCases: thin boxes allowed (min side 4 for lines vs 40 for other elements)
connector without xfrm geometry skipped with PPTX-IMPORT-CONNECTOR warning
knownLimitations: straight lines only (no elbows/curves); no shape-attachment endpoints (free-floating); arrowhead at end only
evidence: engines/format-conversion/test/pptx.test.ts line round-trip; python-pptx cross-validation; scripts/smoke-slides.mjs line scenario
verification: unit + independent python-pptx parse + jsdom smoke; not independently reviewed

name: Office-style ribbon
description: Tabbed ribbon (Home/Insert/Slide Show/File) modeled on the Microsoft Office layout: familiar tab, group and command structure with quick-access undo/redo where the app supports it. Every implemented command is re-homed into its Office group fully wired; Office controls Casserole does not support yet are rendered in place but disabled with a 'not yet implemented' tooltip. Own glyph icons — no Microsoft artwork.
acceptance: existing controls keep working after the move (all prior smokes pass unchanged)
at least one new ribbon-only action works (styles/clipboard/new slide)
edgeCases: controls are physically re-homed so listeners and ids survive
a missing control id is silently not shown rather than faked
knownLimitations: placeholder density is representative, not exhaustive — Office ships hundreds of commands
no contextual tabs (e.g. Table Design), no ribbon collapse, no keytips
